Game Overview

In Flappy Alien, the core idea is straightforward: guide a quirky alien through a cosmic obstacle course in Flappy Alien. Master intuitive tap controls to dodge asteroids, fine-tuning your reflexes as speed intensifies. With every flap, stay airborne amidst unpredictable space challenges, blending nostalgia with an exhilarating test of rhythm and precision.
